As i lay upon a setting sun and rising stars i know may battle is done...ive done all I can all we can to make it better we gave everything our our future to give them what we hopped would be the best possible outcome i dont know if it's enough we never wanted this and neither did they but this is what's become of us corpses. Corpses on the battle field of a war that wasn't ours but I fought it i fought it for them... for everyone I give my life watch the sun rise on the future  for me 
Thank you

Thank you for sharing something so deeply personal. Your words feel like the final thoughts of someone who gave everything—not because they wanted war, but because they wanted a better future for those who would come after them. There is grief, sacrifice, and love in every line. May the sunrise you speak of become a symbol that their sacrifice was not forgotten. ❤‍🩹🌅⚔
Beautiful  and painful  and heavenly
Thank you… beautiful and painful is exactly what I hoped this piece would feel like. ❤🥀
Don't feel of pain as me just keep focus  my survive to be alone
Stay focused, keep surviving, and keep moving forward. Sometimes being alone is how we find our strength. ❤

I float across the lonely universe. Seeking rest in the blanket of stars. Andromeda I miss the touch of your lips and now there is a vast open space separating us.
I am left cold like the dark side of the moon.
Come back my love, keep me from sinking into this black abyss.....

Your words feel like a love letter drifting through the universe—beautiful, lonely, and impossibly far away. “The dark side of the moon” carries such a powerful sense of longing and emptiness. Thank you for giving the music your own story.
God protect the nature from this evil mankind
Love hell of pain

I played this over the scene of Boromir against the orcs whe  the first arrow strikes him, where he fights til his last breath. This music depicted that pure last-stand determination perfectly.

That’s such a powerful scene to pair with this music. Boromir’s final stand carries that exact feeling of determination—knowing the end is near, but refusing to stop protecting those behind him. I’m honored the music could add something to that moment. ⚔❤‍🔥

There a rarity amongst 
Not one made for War not one born of war
But one,
Entire existence 
Dawn of the red sun
To the rise of the 
 black moon..
From every waking hour day  to every lonely nights sleep..
ALL WAR..

Yet,

Stands here amongst us.. we owe a debt we can not pay but today, we settle, 
We all die here before we do we end this ...
For I guarantee,
Tomorrow, WAR will no longer..

We fight, we kill , we die
For those who you can not

There’s a tragedy in those words — not someone born for war, but someone whose entire existence was shaped by it. From the first light of dawn to the coldest night, war became the story they could never escape. Thank you for turning this music into such a powerful story. ⚔🌅🌑
